messages:
maria: Opening follow-up: brief 401 bursts + missing audit lines in token-validate around 02:12 UTC. Need owners, quick mitigations, and an automated detector.

tom: I'll own short-term client mitigations. Plan: add 2 retry attempts with small jitter behind a feature flag. Filing INF-27411. ETA 48h.

dana: I'll take audit reliability. Hypothesis: buffer overflow during memcache evictions. Plan: add disk spillover and dropped_audit_events_total metric. Filing SRE-11221. ETA 1 week.

niles: Infra will tune cache TTLs and autoscale triggers. Quick PR to staging to raise hot-token TTL to 5m and add scale-up on 65% miss. ETA 3 days.

sec-bot: Created recurring follow-up "token-validate-remediate" weekly for 3 weeks. Invite sent.

maria: Thanks — please post PR/JIRA links here when available. We'll close after PRs merged, alerts quiet for 48h, and SEC sign-off if keys/perm changes required.
